name: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge Dataset
description: The RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge dataset is an expert-curated chest radiography benchmark created by the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), the Society of Thoracic Radiology (STR), and the NIH Clinical Center. Derived from a subset of the NIH ChestX-ray14 repository, the dataset comprises 29,684 frontal view chest radiographs in DICOM format. A panel of 18 board-certified thoracic radiologists systematically reviewed and annotated each radiograph for lung opacities suspicious for pneumonia, providing bounding-box spatial annotations for lung opacities alongside normal and non-pneumonia opacity classifications.
